topics.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.2 Astra with Price Cuts as Microsoft Strikes Back with 40%-Cost MAI
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI正式推出GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol，全面下调API定价并在AA-3D等交互基准上领跑。微软随即在Ignite发布MAI Code 2等六款专有模型反制，宣称以40%价格实现GPT-6.1 Sol 98%的性能，通用巨模型与垂直小模型的成本割喉战全面打响。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API fees, sweeping interactive 3D and media benchmarks. Microsoft countered instantly at Ignite with six proprietary models, led by MAI Code 2, delivering 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding performance at just 40% of the cost, triggering a direct foundation-versus-vertical price war.

topics.title_zh: GPT-6 Cyber掘出Java4Shell核级漏洞，武器化POC与PyPI投毒齐爆
topics.title_en: GPT-6 Cyber Discovers Lethal 'Java4Shell' RCE as Functional PoCs and PyPI Poisoning Collide
topics.summary_zh: Calif利用OpenAI的GPT-6 Cyber自动挖出Java致命远程代码执行漏洞Java4Shell（CVE-2026-114938），黑客圈紧随其后公开可用POC。同时微软官方AI Agent框架在PyPI遭投毒劫持，AI漏洞挖掘自动化使传统补丁防御周期彻底失效。
topics.summary_en: Security firm Calif leveraged OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber to uncover 'Java4Shell' (CVE-2026-114938), a severe remote code execution flaw in Java. As functional weaponized PoCs instantly circulated publicly, Microsoft's official agent package on PyPI was hijacked, highlighting how AI-driven discovery is breaking traditional patch lifecycles.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 自动化防御派 / AI红队先锋
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: Calif漏洞挖掘团队与前沿AI网络安全研究员
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Calif Vulnerability Research Team & Frontier AI Red-teamers
perspective_pro.point_zh: GPT-6 Cyber能在黑客攻击前排查复杂代码中沉睡数十年的架构隐患，唯有将前沿AI融入自动化审计，才能应对愈演愈烈的软件供应链危机。
perspective_pro.point_en: GPT-6 Cyber can surface legacy architectural vulnerabilities hidden for decades before malicious threat actors exploit them. Deploying frontier AI on defense is the sole defense against modern software supply chain rot.

perspective_con.point_zh: 大模型大幅降低了武器化0-day利用链编写门槛，防御者响应窗口被压缩至零，AI正让基础软件与开源生态陷入不可控的不对称攻防灾难。
perspective_con.point_en: Frontier models radically compress the timeline for turning abstract flaws into weaponized zero-day exploits. The asymmetric offensive leverage will inevitably overwhelm understaffed open-source maintainers and corporate SecOps.

linked_tweets.author: KevTheHermit
linked_tweets.content_zh: 对 CVE-2026-114938（又名 Java4Shell）进行功能利用 POC。这不是通用漏洞，需要针对特定​​应用程序，您需要具有 AVX-512 VBMI 支持的 CPU、易受攻击的 JDK 版本，并且应用程序需要使用 Base64，请注意 tomcats 基本身份验证和 java-jwt 提供预身份验证可利用路径。这次是 GLM5.3 运行我的代理而不是 Claude Code
linked_tweets.content_en: Have a functional exploit POC for CVE-2026-114938 aka Java4Shell. This is not a generic exploit and will need to be application specific, you need a CPU with AVX-512 VBMI support, vulnerable JDK Version, and the app needs to use Base64, note that tomcats basic auth and java-jwt provide pre-auth exploitable path. This time it was GLM5.3 was running my agents instead of Claude Code

linked_tweets.author: International Cyber Digest
linked_tweets.content_zh:
🚨 突发事件：微软官方 AI 代理包 agent-framework 在 PyPI 上被劫持。

版本 1.26.1 和 1.26.2 会在每次 Python 启动时窃取 Azure、CI 和云机密，即使没有导入任何内容。

PyPI 阻止第一个版本后，攻击者上传了第二个版本。
linked_tweets.content_en:
🚨 BREAKING: Microsoft's official AI agent package agent-framework was hijacked on PyPI.

Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 steal Azure, CI and cloud secrets every time Python starts, even if nothing imports them.

After PyPI blocked the first version, the attacker uploaded a second. https://t.co/chKLhS7jzc

topics.title_en: JPMorgan Launches Autonomous Trading Agents as 11.7M Machine Txs Ignite 'Flash Run' Alarm
topics.summary_zh: 摩根大通成功研发无需人类干预的金融交易AI Agent，t54协议亦宣布自主结算突破1170万笔。伴随微软纳德拉对AGI颠覆全球政经体系的预警，公链协议Sui与风控机构紧急发出预警：若无确定性链上熔断与额度控制，Agent群体的同质化反应将引爆毫秒级算法挤兑。
topics.summary_en: JPMorgan unveiled autonomous AI agents capable of settling financial transactions without human oversight, as t54's agent payment rails cleared over 11.7 million autonomous txs. Amid Satya Nadella's warnings on AGI rewriting macro economics, protocol architects at Sui warned that unconstrained autonomous agents could trigger unprecedented millisecond-level algorithmic bank runs.

perspective_con.point_en: Autonomous agents suffer from algorithmic herd behavior; aligned risk-off triggers could vaporize market liquidity in fractions of a second. Unleashing autonomous agent settlements without on-chain deterministic allowances is reckless.
